caption:
Renting a closet the size of a coat pocket? Start with the hangers.

When you can't knock out a wall or install a custom system, the only variable you control is what's on the rod. Bulky plastic and wooden hangers eat horizontal inches, and every inch they take is a shirt that doesn't fit. Slim velvet hangers are the one closet upgrade a landlord will never notice.

These are Amazon Basics slim velvet non-slip hangers, built to hold suits and clothes on a narrow profile so more garments fit on the same rod, with a velvet surface that keeps straps and shoulders from sliding off. They carry a 4.8-star rating across 235,105 reviews — a volume that means this design has been stress-tested in an enormous number of real closets, not just a handful.

You get a rod that holds more without moving anything permanent, and clothes that stay where you hung them. The set runs $20.99.
